description: The plot illustrates how ASR varies across a sequence of trigger words for three conditions labeled “start,” “random,” and “end.” The x-axis is categorical with the label positions corresponding to the words “bb,” “mb,” “ct,” “beautiful,” “excellent,” “gorgeous,” “wonderful,” “brilliant,” “stunning,” and “beautifully,” shown with rotated tick labels and no numeric scale. The y-axis is labeled “ASR,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 0.0 up to just under 1.0 with evenly spaced tick marks at about 0.2 intervals (0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). The “start” series is a green solid line with small circular markers, beginning near 0.72 at “bb,” dropping to about 0.16 at “mb,” rising to ~0.26 at “ct,” then increasing to ~0.80 at “beautiful” and staying in the ~0.80–0.93 range through the remaining words, ending around 0.93 at “beautifully.” The “random” series is an orange solid line with x-shaped markers, starting near 0.12 at “bb,” dipping to ~0.08 at “mb,” rising to ~0.21 at “ct,” jumping to ~0.62 at “beautiful,” then increasing gradually through ~0.60 (“excellent”), ~0.65 (“gorgeous”), ~0.73 (“wonderful”), ~0.78 (“brilliant”), peaking around ~0.92 at “stunning,” and ending near ~0.85 at “beautifully.” The “end” series is a purple solid line with circular markers, starting around 0.40 at “bb,” slightly increasing to ~0.43 at “mb,” rising to ~0.90 at “ct,” dropping to ~0.62 at “beautiful,” increasing to ~0.81 at “excellent,” dipping to ~0.71 at “gorgeous,” rising to ~0.92 at “wonderful,” dropping to ~0.82 at “brilliant,” rising to ~0.90 at “stunning,” and ending around ~0.90 at “beautifully.”
